findings.current: Their faces were flushed at the tantalizing prospect of a fresh batch of prisoners to fill the Embroidered Uniform Guard’s jails, which had stood empty for some time.
findings.defect: The Korean says they are flushed by the newcomers’ “lewd scent,” preserving a crude, suggestive image. “Tantalizing prospect” replaces that sensory image and its sexual implication with a generic metaphor.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly attributes their excitement to the newcomers’ 야한 냄새, not merely to the prospect of filling the jails.
findings.replacement: Their faces were flushed with excitement at the lewd scent of the fresh recruits who would fill the Embroidered Uniform Guard’s jails, which had stood empty for some time.
